scope.working_tree: all Round 16B changed, staged, and untracked files
scope.history: all ordinary blobs introduced after source_sha
scope.baseline_exception: Inherited source objects are immutable baseline evidence; no new exception may be added.

predicted_large_artifact_classes: higher-order incidence, composition, state, transition, workflow, and export censuses
API, production HTTP, concurrency, memory, and export replay case ledgers

sharding_policy.required_identity: Every shard name and manifest row must include a deterministic tranche or range identity.
sharding_policy.required_manifest: Every sharded dataset must have ordered row counts, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

decision: Any changed file at or above 50,000,000 hydrated bytes must be LFS-managed. Any newly introduced ordinary blob at or above 90,000,000 bytes blocks commit and publication.
